paragraphs.text: Duskana is a bear from Ravnica .

First spotted roaming the Rubblebelt after a failed summoning rite by Yarus , Duskana is not a normal bear. Rumors abound of her ability to appear out of seemingly nowhere, and those who see her often find themselves filled with a bestial rage that prompts them to go on destructive rampages. Some have speculated that she might be the "pale bear" of Gruul prophecy that will herald the rise of old gods . She is invariably seen with her three cubs, whom she guards fiercely.
